pageProps.title: If We Cannot Move at the Speed of Light
pageProps.review: A book review of Kim Cho-yeop's short story collection 'If We Cannot Move at the Speed of Light', which conveys warm emotions and fresh imagination centered on humans rather than technology through 'Symbiosis Hypothesis' and 'Missing in the Library'.
pageProps.description: People who knew my story came to me for decades and offered words of comfort. They told me to take solace in the fact that you are still within the same universe.
pageProps.content:
## Review I read this book because it was recommended in my reading club. Rather than the book itself, I was recommended the author Kim Cho-yeop. Since it's a short story collection, it was good to feel the author's style in one volume. I should read her other works as well.
```Symbiosis Hypothesis``` was fresh. It was an interesting hypothesis about the phenomenon of childhood amnesia. The library in ```Missing in the Library``` seemed like a technology that could be possible in the future.
Stories centered on ```the humans who use technology```, not just the technology itself.
